  module status          Show the installed/used businessdev.ALbuild module.

albuild configure docker - Show, or move, the directory Docker keeps images and container layers in.
  [destructive] Needs --yes when stdin is not a terminal.

On a build server this one directory decides how much can be cached and how many
containers fit: a BC container restores its database into its writable layer, and a
version image costs about 6.4 GB. A Docker root on the system drive is what caps a
build host long before its CPU or RAM do.

Without --data-root this only reports. With it, the new root starts EMPTY and images
are pulled again on demand - the layer store is deliberately NOT copied, because
Windows layers are hard links plus NTFS metadata and copying them produces images
that cannot be removed. Nothing is deleted either: the old store stays where it is,
which is what makes the rollback complete. Needs an elevated shell.
